forecastingTypeId.title: Forecasting Type ID
forecastingTypeId.description: Salesforce ID of the active ForecastingType, from Get_Forecasting_Context.

userId.title: User ID
userId.description: Salesforce User ID (005...) of the managing user whose team forecast to summarize, from Get_Forecasting_Context. Team membership is resolved server-side from this manager's role hierarchy.

periodId.title: Period ID
periodId.description: Salesforce ID of the current ForecastingPeriod, from Get_Forecasting_Context.

territoryId.title: Territory ID
territoryId.description: Optional Territory2 ID for territory-hierarchy forecast types.

forecastingCategories.title: Forecasting Categories
forecastingCategories.description: List of forecast category API names to filter by. Derived from resolvedForecastingCategories.
